BEGIN TRANSACTION;

-- Purane bills aur unke items delete karein
DELETE FROM SaleItems;
DELETE FROM Sales;

-- Stock movement history clear karein
DELETE FROM StockMovements;

-- Products aur customers clear karein
DELETE FROM Products;
DELETE FROM Customers;

-- Login ko default par reset karein
UPDATE Users
SET Username = 'admin',
    Password = 'admin123'
WHERE UserID = 1;

-- Auto-generated IDs ko reset karein, agar sequence entries hain
DELETE FROM sqlite_sequence
WHERE name IN (
    'Products',
    'Customers',
    'Sales',
    'SaleItems',
    'StockMovements'
);

COMMIT;
